## Overview

70s warmth, 80s neon. Analog soul. This is the "arcade-night" design system, and this file is the single source of truth for visual decisions in the project. The front matter holds the tokens and is the normative part; the sections below say how to apply them.

Written by kernic to the DESIGN.md `alpha` spec. Regenerate it, and the token files beside it, with `kernic context arcade-night`.

## Colors

Roles, with the light value first:

- **Background** `--background` `#f5f6fe` (dark `#13131a`): page background.
- **Surface** `--surface` `#e9eaf3` (dark `#25262e`): cards, panels, inputs.
- **Text** `--text` `#13131a` (dark `#f5f6fe`): body copy and headings.
- **Muted text** `--muted-text` `#666875` (dark `#9fa0ae`): secondary text, captions, placeholders.
- **Border** `--border` `#d5d7e1` (dark `#393a43`): hairlines and dividers.
- **Ring** `--ring` `#896cd8`: focus rings.
- **Primary** `--color-primary-600` (hover `--color-primary-500`): buttons, links, the one action on a screen.
- **Accent** `--color-accent-500`: highlights, badges, secondary emphasis. Never a large surface.

Dark mode swaps every role for its dark value. Nothing gets darkened by hand.

## Typography

- Headings: "Unbounded"
- Body: "IBM Plex Sans"
- Code: "JetBrains Mono"

No other families. Sizes come from a 1.333 scale on 1rem; the roles in the front matter (display, heading, subheading, body, small, label, code) sit on these steps, each with its line height.

| Token | Size | Line height |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--text-xs` | `0.750rem` | `1.5` |
| `--text-sm` | `0.866rem` | `1.5` |
| `--text-base` | `1.000rem` | `1.5` |
| `--text-lg` | `1.333rem` | `1.4` |
| `--text-xl` | `1.777rem` | `1.3` |
| `--text-2xl` | `2.369rem` | `1.25` |
| `--text-3xl` | `4.209rem` | `1.2` |
| `--text-4xl` | `7.478rem` | `1.1` |
| `--text-5xl` | `13.288rem` | `1.05` |

Weights: regular 400, medium 500, semibold 600, bold 700 (`--font-weight-*`). Tracking: tight `-0.02em` for display and headings, normal `0em` for body, wide `0.04em` for labels and small caps (`--tracking-*`).

Load the fonts with:

```css
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap");
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap");
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap");
```

## Layout

### Spacing

The unit is `0.25rem` (`--spacing`). Named steps are `--space-*`, in rem: 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16. Padding, gaps and margins come from this scale and nothing off it.

### Breakpoints and containers

Breakpoints (`--breakpoint-*`): sm 40rem, md 48rem, lg 64rem, xl 80rem, 2xl 96rem. Containers (`--container-*`): sm 40rem, md 48rem, lg 64rem, xl 80rem. Prose measures `65ch` (`--measure`).

### Motion

Transitions are lively: fast `120ms`, base `220ms`, slow `360ms` (`--duration-*`). Easing: out `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` for things arriving, in-out `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` for things moving, emphasized `cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1)` for the one moment that deserves it (`--ease-*`). No overshoot on state changes. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` by dropping the transition, not the state.

## Elevation & Depth

Layers are separated first by color: `--surface` sits on `--background`, and `--border` draws the hairline between them. Shadows add depth on top and are tinted from the neutral ramp, so they belong to the palette. Each has a light and a dark value; dark mode uses the denser set.

- `--shadow-xs`: inputs and small controls at rest. Light `0px 1px 2px 0px #13131a14`.
- `--shadow-sm`: cards at rest. Light `0px 1px 3px 0px #13131a1a, 0px 1px 2px -1px #13131a1a`.
- `--shadow-md`: cards on hover, dropdowns. Light `0px 4px 6px -1px #13131a1a, 0px 2px 4px -2px #13131a1a`.
- `--shadow-lg`: popovers, floating panels. Light `0px 10px 15px -3px #13131a1a, 0px 4px 6px -4px #13131a1a`.
- `--shadow-xl`: dialogs and sheets. Light `0px 20px 25px -5px #13131a1a, 0px 8px 10px -6px #13131a1a`.

## Shapes

Corners are round: `--radius-sm` 0.375rem, `--radius-md` 0.625rem (the default), `--radius-lg` 1rem, `--radius-xl` 1.5rem. `rounded.full` (9999px) is for pills and avatars only.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Use only the tokens in this file, by their CSS variable names.
- Put page backgrounds on `--background`, cards and panels on `--surface`, body text in `--text`, secondary text in `--muted-text`, hairlines in `--border`.
- Use `--color-primary-600` for primary actions, `--color-primary-500` on hover, and `--ring` for focus rings.
- Set headings in "Unbounded", body in "IBM Plex Sans", code in "JetBrains Mono".
- Take type sizes from `--text-*`, weights from `--font-weight-*`, corner radii from `--radius-*`, spacing from `--space-*`, shadows from `--shadow-*`.
- Animate with `--duration-*` and `--ease-*`, and turn transitions off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Switch to the dark values of the semantic tokens and shadows in dark mode.

### Don't

- Invent raw hex, `rgb()` or named CSS colors.
- Use any font family other than the three above.
- Darken or lighten a color by hand for dark mode.
- Put the accent color on a large surface; it is for highlights, badges and secondary emphasis.
- Use a type size, radius, spacing, shadow or duration that is not a token.
- Use `transition: all`, or an easing that overshoots, on a state change.
